ios.desc:
Put Scripture on every screen you look at.

Shepherd turns your iPhone into a daily reminder of God's Word — with widgets for your home screen and lock screen, an auto-updating verse wallpaper, and a studio for turning any verse into something beautiful enough to share.

WIDGETS FOR EVERY SCREEN
• Verse of the Day on your home screen, in small, medium, large, and iPad sizes
• Lock screen widgets, so today's verse is there every time you check the time
• Choose what your widget shows: the daily verse, the passage you're reading, or daily artwork
• Pick your translation and theme for each widget

DAILY VERSE WALLPAPER
• A fresh wallpaper with today's verse, every day — set it up once and it updates automatically
• Two styles: the classic antique look, or daily artwork created for each day's verse
• Matches light and dark mode on its own

THE VERSE IMAGE STUDIO
• Turn any verse into a shareable image in seconds
• 50 hand-crafted antique palettes — parchment, oxblood, sage, midnight ink, and more
• A library of classic serif typefaces
• Square, Story, landscape, and wallpaper formats
• Use your own photos as backgrounds, or generate unique AI verse artwork

A READER THAT STAYS OUT OF THE WAY
• Six translations: KJV, NIV, ESV, NLT, NKJV, NASB
• Download translations for offline reading
• Highlights, notes, and a bookmark that syncs across your devices
• The words of Jesus in red
• Fast full-text search

SHEPHERD STUDIO (optional subscription)
Everything above is free — the daily verse, the widgets, the wallpaper automation, and the starter studio. Shepherd Studio unlocks the full creative toolkit: all 50 palettes, every font, your own photo backgrounds, high-resolution exports, and 20 AI verse images every month. Monthly or yearly; cancel anytime. Prefer no subscription? AI verse images are also available as simple one-time packs.

No ads. No tracking. Just the Word, beautifully.
